newsitem.title: NORWAY: Oslo Bourse flat, but Fokus up on takeover talk.
newsitem.headline: Oslo Bourse flat, but Fokus up on takeover talk.

text.p: Shares in Fokus Bank jumped on renewed speculation on Tuesday that Norway's fourth largest bank will be taken over by competitors, dealers said.

The share closed three crowns, or 4.29 percent, higher at 73 crowns to again match a hostile takeover bid made recently by Sparebankgruppen, a group of 16 regional savings banks seeking to swallow Fokus.
Turnover in Fokus was heavy at 278 million crowns.
Otherwise, the Oslo Total index traded in negative territory for most of the session only to gain strength in the afternoon from Wall Street's higher opening.
The Total index closed 0.49 percent higher at 1,094.64 points in turnover worth 1.2 billion crowns.
Fokus on Monday recommended its shareholders to turn down the 73 crowns per share takeover bid by Sparebankgruppen but did not rule out other bids may come soon.
Dealers said the securities department of Den norske Bank (DNB) had vacuumed the market for Fokus shares, but DnB declined comment.
Analysts have suggested that a large Norwegian or another Nordic bank would make a higher offer for Fokus.
